name: Tupul Railway Station Landslide
sourceTitle: 8 killed, 45 missing in massive landslide in Manipur - The Hindu (30 Jun 2022)
actualOutcome: Landslide hit Tupul railway construction camp on the night of 29-30 Jun 2022; dozens killed (56+ bodies later recovered).
note: Model chook gaya: rain24=10.6mm, rain3d=31.2mm, rain30d=312.2mm model ko kam lage, lekin landslide ho gaya. Model sirf baarish/mitti/dhalan dekhta hai - sadak/rail ke liye pahad kaatna (slope cutting), kharab drainage, construction debris jaise insaani kaaran ye nahi dekh pata (Tupul par GSI ne slope-cutting ko bada kaaran mana tha). Case note: GSI ki preliminary report ne Tupul ke liye extensive slope-cutting (railway station ke liye pahad kaatna), dumped construction debris aur improper drainage ko bada kaaran mana - ye cheezein model dekh hi nahi sakta. ERA5 grid (~10-25 km) par ghatna se ek din pehle ki baarish sirf 10.6mm aayi, jabki May-June me ilaake me record baarish ho chuki thi (rain30d=312mm) - maati andar se kamzor thi, lekin model ka score threshold tak nahi pahuncha. [Coords: event place coords (approx); slope/history: nearest zone rz-7 Haflong (slope 31, High)]

sourceTitle: Three killed as rains and landslides wreak havoc in Assam - The Indian Express (16 May 2022)
actualOutcome: 11-18 May 2022 heavy rain triggered 1000s of landslides in Dima Hasao; New Haflong station buried by debris flows, a family of three killed in Haflong.
note: Model chook gaya: rain24=31.6mm, rain3d=68.0mm, rain30d=213.2mm model ko kam lage, lekin landslide ho gaya. Case note: Research paper (Landslides journal, Roy et al.) ke mutabik Haflong me sabse zyada 24h baarish 156mm 11 May ko aayi thi aur ~200mm 4-din antecedent baarish ne landslides trigger kiye.
